## MedplumClientOptions.tokenUrl property

OAuth2 token URL.

Default value is `baseUrl + "/oauth2/token"`<!-- -->.

Can be specified as absolute URL or relative to baseUrl.

Use this if you want to use a separate OAuth server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
tokenUrl?: string;
```
